meta.name: cheat-publish
meta.description: 登记一篇内容已发布，把 URL/平台 ID/发布时间写入对应预测文件 header 和 state file。这是一个轻量动作——只更新元数据，**不动预测段任何字符**。触发词："已发布"/"I shipped"/"发布链接是 X"/"刚发完 [url]"/"publish registered"。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录内容发布信息到预测文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要追踪内容是否已发布并更新相关元数据。
copy.tagline_en: Record content publication info into prediction files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track whether content is published and update related metadata.

howto.what: 安装后，当你告诉 Claude 内容已发布并提供链接，它会自动记录发布信息（如平台、时间、URL）到对应的预测文件中，但不会修改预测内容本身。
howto.when: 当你提到“已发布”、“I shipped”、“发布链接是X”、“刚发完 [url]”或“publish registered”等关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会找到对应的预测文件并更新发布元数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you tell Claude that content has been published and provide a link, it will record the publication metadata (platform, time, URL) into the corresponding prediction file without modifying the prediction content itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "已发布", "I shipped", "发布链接是X", "刚发完 [url]", or "publish registered".

say_en.note: Claude will find the prediction file and update publication metadata.
Claude will detect platform as bilibili and ask for publish time.
